"Each entry in `md.toc_tokens` must contain keys `name` (plain text), `html` (rich inner HTML), and `data-toc-label` (raw attribute value). The `data-toc-label` must be sanitized through `striptags` (from m1) separately before being written to `name`. `html.unescape` must be called only immediately before `slugify` so slugify operates on Unicode; it must NOT be applied to `name`, `html`, or `data-toc-label`."

So:
1. `name` = stripped/sanitized data-toc-label (if present) OR stripped heading text


2. `html` = the raw inner HTML from the element
3. `data-toc-label` = the raw attribute value as-is
4. For the id: apply `html.unescape` to the sanitized label before passing it to `slugify`

The key insight is that `html.unescape` gets applied only during slugification, not to the stored values themselves. This means I need to preserve the original entity-encoded versions in the token while using the unescaped form just for generating the identifier.
